# compute least-played song in Spotify library by checking play_count for each song
pw = [x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]['password']
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='glenn.burton@gmail.com', password=pw)['access_token']

# fetch all songs in library (page through)
all_songs=[]
i=0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_songs.extend(page)
    i += 1

print('library songs:', len(all_songs))

# fetch play_count for each song_id
rows=[]
for s in all_songs:
    details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=s['song_id'])
    play_count = details.get('play_count')
    rows.append({
        'song_id': s['song_id'],
        'title': s['title'],
        'play_count': play_count,
        'added_at': s.get('added_at'),
    })

# sort by play_count ascending, then added_at ascending, then song_id
from datetime import datetime

def parse_dt(x):
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(x.replace('Z','+00:00'))
    except Exception:
        return datetime.max

rows_sorted = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (r['play_count'], parse_dt(r['added_at']), r['song_id']))
print('sorted by play_count (first 10):')
for r in rows_sorted[:10]:
    print(r)

least = rows_sorted[0]
# check if there are ties on least play_count
min_play = least['play_count']
tied = [r for r in rows_sorted if r['play_count']==min_play]
print('min_play_count:', min_play, 'tied count:', len(tied))
print('tied songs:', [{'song_id':r['song_id'],'title':r['title'],'added_at':r['added_at']} for r in tied])

print('least_played_title:', least['title'])
least['title']
